cmd: d=$(mktemp -d) && git clone -q "$(git remote get-url origin)" "$d/fresh" && test -z "$(git -C "$d/fresh" log --all --oneline -- config.js)" && test -z "$(git ls-remote "$(git remote get-url origin)" "refs/pull/*")" && while IFS= read -r line; do lit=${line%%==>*}; test -n "$lit" && test -z "$(git -C "$d/fresh" log --all -F -S"$lit" --oneline)" || exit 1; done < "$REPLACE_LIST"
